pandas.pivot_table

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Group rows and columns into a summary table. Use aggfunc to control how repeated combinations are reduced.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.pivot_table(…) Full signature
pd.pivot_table(
    data,
    values=None,
    index=None,
    columns=None,
    aggfunc='mean',
    fill_value=None,
    margins=False,
    dropna=True,
    margins_name='All',
    observed=True,
    sort=True,
    **kwargs,
)
